1.text: Mbere na mbere hariho Jambo; Jambo uwo yahoranye n'Imana kandi Jambo yari Imana.

2.text: Uwo yahoranye n'Imana mbere na mbere.

3.text: Ibintu byose ni we wabiremye, ndetse mu byaremwe byose nta na kimwe kitaremwe na we.

4.text: Muri we harimo ubugingo, kandi ubwo bugingo bwari Umucyo w'abantu.

5.text: Uwo Mucyo uvira mu mwijima, ariko umwijima ntiwawumenya.

6.text: Hariho umuntu watumwe n'Imana witwaga Yohana.

7.text: Uwo yazanywe no guhamya iby'Umucyo, ngo atume bose bizera.

8.text: Icyakora uwo si we uwo Mucyo, ahubwo ni we wahamije ibyawo.

9.text: Uwo Mucyo ni we Mucyo nyakuri, kandi ubwo ni bwo yatangiraga kuza mu isi ngo amurikire umuntu wese.

10.text: Yari mu isi ndetse ni we wayiremye, nyamara ab'isi ntibamumenya.

11.text: Yaje mu bye, ariko abe ntibamwemera.

12.text: Icyakora abamwemeye bose bakizera izina rye, yabahaye ubushobozi bwo kuba abana b'Imana.

13.text: Abo ntibabyawe n'amaraso cyangwa n'ubushake bw'umubiri, cyangwa n'ubushake bw'umugabo, ahubwo babyawe n'Imana.

14.text: Jambo uwo yabaye umuntu abana natwe (tubona ubwiza bwe busa n'ubw'Umwana w'ikinege wa Se), yuzuye ubuntu n'ukuri.

15.text: Yohana yahamije iby'uwo avuga yeruye ati “Uwo ni we navuze nti ‘Uzaza hanyuma ni we unduta, kuko yahozeho ntarabaho.’ ”

16.text: Kandi ibimwuzuye akaba ari byo twahaweho twese, ni ubuntu bukurikira ubundi,

17.text: kuko amategeko yatanzwe na Mose, ariko ubuntu n'ukuri byo byazanywe na Yesu Kristo.

18.text: Uhereye kera kose nta muntu wigeze kubona Imana, ahubwo Umwana w'ikinege uri mu gituza cya Se, ni we wayimenyekanishije.

19.text: Ibi ni byo Yohana yahamije, ubwo Abayuda bamutumagaho abatambyi n'Abalewi, bavanywe i Yerusalemu no kumubaza bati “Uri nde?”

20.text: Nuko ntiyabahisha ukuri, ahubwo araberurira ati “Si jye Kristo.”

21.text: Nuko baramubaza bati “Tubwire, uri Eliya?”Na we ati “Sindi we.”Bati “Uri wa muhanuzi?”Arabasubiza ati “Oya.”

22.text: Baramubaza bati “None se uri nde ngo dusubize abadutumye? Wowe wiyita nde?”

23.text: Ati “Ndi ijwi ry'urangururira mu butayu ngo ‘Nimugorore inzira y'Uwiteka’, nk'uko umuhanuzi Yesaya yabivuze.”

25.text: Nuko baramubaza bati “None ubatiriza iki, ko utari Kristo, ntube na Eliya, ntube na wa muhanuzi?”

26.text: Yohana arabasubiza ati “Jye ndabatirisha amazi, ariko muri mwe hahagaze uwo mutaramenya,

27.text: uwo ni we unsimbura kandi ntibinkwiriye gupfundura udushumi tw'inkweto ze.”

28.text: Ibyo byabereye i Betaniya hakurya ya Yorodani, aho Yohana yabatirizaga.

29.text: Bukeye bw'aho abona Yesu aza aho ari aravuga ati “Nguyu Umwana w'intama w'Imana, ukuraho ibyaha by'abari mu isi.

30.text: Uyu ni we navuze nti ‘Nyuma yanjye hazaza umugabo unduta ubukuru, kuko yahozeho ntarabaho.’

31.text: Icyakora sinari muzi, ariko kugira ngo yerekwe Abisirayeli, ni cyo cyatumye nza mbatirisha amazi.”

32.text: Kandi Yohana arahamya ati “Nabonye Umwuka amanuka ava mu ijuru asa n'inuma, atinda kuri we.

33.text: Icyakora sinari muzi, keretse yuko Iyantumye kubatirisha amazi yambwiye iti ‘Uwo uzabona Umwuka amanukira akagwa kuri we, uwo ni we ubatirisha Umwuka Wera’.

34.text: Nanjye mbibonye, mpamya yuko ari Umwana w'Imana.”

35.text: Bukeye bw'aho, Yohana yongera guhagararana n'abigishwa be babiri.

36.text: Yitegereza Yesu agenda aravuga ati “Nguyu Umwana w'intama w'Imana.”

37.text: Abo bigishwa bombi bumvise avuze atyo, bakurikira Yesu.

38.text: Yesu arahindukira abona bamukurikiye arababaza ati “Murashaka iki?” Baramusubiza bati “Rabi, (risobanurwa ngo: Mwigisha) ucumbitse he?”

39.text: Arababwira ati “Nimuze murahabona.” Barajyana babona aho acumbitse. Hari nk'isaha cumi, baherako bamarana na we umwanya burīra.

40.text: Andereya mwene se wa Simoni Petero, yari umwe muri abo babiri bumvise Yohana bagakurikira Yesu.

41.text: Abanza kubona mwene se Simoni aramubwira ati “Twabonye Mesiya” (risobanurwa ngo: Kristo).

42.text: Amuzanira Yesu, na we aramwitegereza aramubwira ati “Uri Simoni mwene Yona, uzitwa Kefa.” (Risobanurwa ngo: ibuye).

43.text: Bukeye bwaho Yesu ashaka kujya i Galilaya. Abona Filipo aramubwira ati “Nkurikira.”

44.text: Filipo uwo yari uw'i Betsayida, umudugudu w'iwabo wa Andereya na Petero.

45.text: Filipo abona Natanayeli aramubwira ati “Uwo Mose yanditse mu mategeko, n'abahanuzi bakamwandika twamubonye. Ni Yesu mwene Yosefu w'i Nazareti.”

46.text: Natanayeli aramubaza ati “Mbese i Nazareti hari icyiza cyahaturuka?” Filipo aramusubiza ati “Ngwino urebe.”

47.text: Yesu abona Natanayeli aza aho ari amuvugaho ati “Dore Umwisirayeli nyakuri, udafite uburiganya.”

48.text: Natanayeli aramubaza ati “Wamenyeye he?” Yesu aramusubiza ati “Filipo ataraguhamagara, ubwo wari munsi y'umutini nakubonye.”

49.text: Natanayeli aramusubiza ati “Rabi, uri Umwana w'Imana koko. Ni wowe Mwami w'Abisirayeli.”

50.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Mbese wijejwe n'uko nkubwiye yuko nakubonye uri munsi y'umutini? Uzabona ibiruta ibyo.”

51.text: Kandi arongera aramubwira ati “Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuko muzabona ijuru rikingutse, abamarayika b'Imana bazamuka bavuye ku Mwana w'umuntu, bakamumanukiraho.”
